about: The west cliffs and the eagle stack (Book 4 section 02; Book 9 sections 03 and 05; Stage 14, decisions S14-1, S14-5 and S14-40): blocks 2 to 13 by 11 to 15, between Gull Geo and the Hag's Seat, expanded by src/tools/levels/zones.ts. The cliff path runs along the heather of the top from the geo to the Hag's Seat; the face stands on the sea to the west; in a bight of it the egg ledges lie below the top, each reached by a marked climb with drawn hand-holds (its head on the top, its foot on the ledge, ten tiles, within climbLedgeEvery), and a fourth short climb goes down to the cleft on the cliff path's halfway ledge; offshore the eagle stack, its eyrie and the eagle on its top, seen from the cliff top (a view point). Edit this plan, not the generated map, then run npm run zones.
